new.note: Full strength, trained 2026-11-19 to chase down the puck after its own block and to cope with a mallet that lags on its cables. Played on the table for 38 minutes on 2026-11-19: about level with 'max', and it recovered more of the slow rebounds off its own block.

calm.note: Full strength, trained 2026-11-20 mostly by playing itself. It takes time to control the puck before it shoots and defends with little movement, to stop pucks going in off its own moving mallet. In simulation it beats 'max' 22-15. Simulation results only: it has not been on the table. Known weakness: it is slower to play a puck lying against the left rail and may wait beside one for a few seconds; stop the AI if it does not move on.

v0.1.0.summary: Production PPO network of the rail30 / 100 m/s^2 work (was rail30-100-20261001-v1). Training reference and opponent only.

v1.0.0.summary: v0.1.0 widened to 1536 and distilled from the physics teacher (was teacher-dagger-20261018-v1).

v2.0.0.summary: PPO from v1.0.0 with possession delay (was teacher-ppo-20261018-v2). Failed its table test: idle jitter.

v3.0.0.summary: v2.0.0 under the measured paddle contact (was teacher-ppo-measured-20261018-v3). Experimental.

v4.0.0.summary: v2.0.0 with the calm-accel cost (was teacher-calm-20261018-v4, 'v4'). 13 table sessions, 2026-10-19 to 11-08.

v4.1.0.summary: v4.0.0 in the table-faithful sim against the table people (was arm a, 'v5a').

v4.1.1.summary: v4.1.0 with the dead-puck clock, guard and effort costs, corner drills (was arm a2).

v4.1.2.summary: v4.1.1 with the two imitation anchors on resting pucks (was arm a3). On the table 2026-11-10 and 11-17.

v4.2.0.summary: v4.1.2 continued 288M steps with its body limited to 40 m/s^2 (units still 100). Sim only.

v4.2.1.summary: v4.1.2 continued 286M steps with its body limited to 25 m/s^2 (units still 100). Sim only.

v4.2.2.summary: v4.1.2 continued 284M steps with its body limited to 15 m/s^2 (units still 100). Sim only.

v4.3.0.summary: v4.1.2 continued 127M steps with the robot mallet compliant on its cables (sim profile table-20261118). Sim only.

v4.3.1.summary: As v4.3.0 with a cost of 30 on returning the puck without control or a real shot. 128M steps. Sim only.

v4.3.2.summary: As v4.3.0 with a softer mallet (gain 0.8-2.5) on every worker. 127M steps. Base of v4.3.4 onward. Sim only.

v4.3.3.summary: As v4.3.1 plus recovery drills to 2.2 m/s with capture and get-ahead bonuses. 83M steps. Sim only.

v4.3.4.summary: v4.3.2 in the calibrated soft-mallet sim (table-20261119) with a cost of 100 on a reachable slow puck leaving. 84M steps. Sim only.

v4.3.5.summary: 'Control first' rewards (shots at a moving puck worth less). Stopped at 48M steps: it lost defense. Not for use.

v4.3.6.summary: As v4.3.4 plus defense drills that continue after the block. 95M steps. Sim only.

v4.3.7.summary: Third attempt at a roaming difficulty model (--roam-weight 100). 21M steps; it does not roam. Not a difficulty model.

v4.3.8.summary: v4.3.6 (at 40M steps) plus chase drills on pucks leaving at 0.6-2.4 m/s with persistent exploration. The file is its 40M-step snapshot; agent.pt (98M) lost the gain. Sim only.

v4.3.9.summary: v4.3.8 continued with a larger policy step (KL 0.05). 48M steps: defense slipped. Not for use.

v4.3.10.summary: v4.3.8 with a stronger push (slow exit costs 200, more follow-through drills, wider exploration). The file is its 40M-step snapshot; the 80M one was weaker. Superseded by v4.3.12. Sim only.

v4.3.11.summary: v4.3.8 tilted toward stopping the puck rather than striking it from behind. 50M steps: lost the gain. Not for use.

v4.3.12.summary: v4.3.8 (at 40M steps) continued with three times the batch per update. The file is its 60M-step snapshot, the best of the study: level `new`. Sim only.

v4.3.13.summary: v4.3.12 (its last file, 90M steps) continued 96M steps with six times the batch per update. As good as v4.3.12 on two seeds, steady from snapshot to snapshot; gates not run. Sim only.

v4.4.0.summary: First launch of the self-play arm (a game pays goals and physical costs only), 63M steps. The two ends were not equal: soft mallet and mallet lift on the learner only. Plays like v4.3.12; not for use. Sim only.

v4.4.1.summary: The self-play arm with equal ends. The file is its 101M-step snapshot: about v4.3.12, with fewer pucks given away. Later snapshots aim at the edge of the sim's goal, which had no posts; do not use them. Sim only.

v4.4.2.summary: The self-play arm continued from v4.4.1 in the sim with goal posts. The file is its 101M-step snapshot: the same play as v4.4.1 within the evaluation's noise. The aim held to 150M steps and moved out again after; later snapshots are no better. Sim only.

v4.4.3.summary: The self-play arm plus one payment in games for a prepared shot (--game-prepared-shot-weight 100, a sixth of a goal), 111M steps. In training prepared shots went from 30% to 33% of on-target shots; against the simulated people nothing measurable changed. The file is its 101M-step snapshot. Sim only.

v4.4.4.summary: v4.4.3 continued with the payment for a prepared shot at 300 (half a goal), 118M steps; the file is its 101M-step snapshot. 40% of its shots come from a controlled puck (v4.4.2 30%), 25 prepared fast on-target shots per 100 possessions (17). Concedes twice as often to the simulated people (0.27 a minute) and, like v4.4.2, loses to v4.1.2 head to head (8-17). Sim only.

v4.4.5.summary: v4.4.4 continued with v4.1.2 and v4.3.12 as fixed opponents in a quarter of the games, 108M steps; the file is its 101M-step snapshot. Keeps v4.4.4's prepared shots (39% from a controlled puck, 25 per 100 possessions) and is level with v4.1.2 head to head (20-18, was 8-17). Still concedes 0.30 a minute to the simulated people, most of it through the mallet lift. Sim only.

v4.4.6.summary: v4.4.5 continued with the learner's mallet lift on in every game (--selfplay-lift), 202M steps (the file). 37-43% of shots from a controlled puck, 72-73% on target, 28-31 prepared fast on-target shots per 100 possessions (v4.3.12 12), concedes 0.22 a minute to the simulated people (v4.1.2 0.32), level with v4.1.2 head to head. NOT FOR THE TABLE: it hovers behind a puck lying at the front edge of its reach (4-5% of resting pucks left, v4.3.12 0.4%), dithering there until the load reaches the shutdown level (3 of 256 rigid-sim games). Sim only.

v4.4.7.summary: v4.4.6 continued with the front-edge resting-puck drill (--reach-edge-drill-fraction 0.3), 202M steps (the file). Best shot quality so far: 47% of shots from a controlled puck, 75% on target, 36 prepared fast on-target shots per 100 possessions (v4.3.12 12), 0.22 conceded a minute, level with v4.1.2 head to head (18-19), load peak 0.92. Resting pucks left 1.3% (v4.4.6 4-5%, v4.1.2 1.0%), the front edge fixed. NOT FOR THE TABLE yet: in 2 of 64 games against the simulated people a puck lay against the right rail for 43 and 56 s. Sim only.

v4.4.8.summary: v4.4.7 continued with the rail-rest drill (--rail-rest-drill-fraction 0.35), 101M steps (the file); stopped. WORSE than its parent: placed resting pucks left 5.1% (v4.4.7 1.3%), the two long rail spells still there, 16-24 against v4.1.2. Do not use; kept as the record of a failed drill. Sim only.

v4.4.9.summary: v4.4.7 continued with hard acceleration costing four times as much outside its own possession (--defense-motion-scale 4), 101M steps (the file); stopped. Shot speed held (6.5 m/s on target) but the defending is hardly calmer (forward lunge on fast shots 91 -> 83 mm, mallet speed at contact unchanged at 1.5-1.6 m/s) and shots from a controlled puck slipped 47% -> 43%. Placed resting pucks left 0.5% (the best yet); long rest spells still occur about once in 64 games. Sim only.

v4.4.10.summary: v4.4.9 continued with the three motion charges times 25 while a shot is incoming (--incoming-motion-scale 25), 202M steps (the file); stopped. Calm defending without softer shots: forward lunge on fast shots 28 mm (v4.1.2 150, v4.4.7 91; the 15 m/s^2 beginner on the table 20), hard reversals gone, goals through a mallet lift 0.08 a minute (v4.4.7 0.13, v4.1.2 0.23), on-target shot speed 6.6 m/s, 43% of shots from a controlled puck. The price: clean goals conceded 0.16 a minute (0.09), total unchanged at 0.24; 13-19 against v4.1.2. NOT FOR THE TABLE yet: placed resting pucks left 2.8% and the right-rail hover is untreated. Sim only.

v4.4.11.summary: v4.4.10 continued with twice the side-rail practice and the rail approach potential at 30 (--edge-drill-fraction 0.3, --edge-approach-weight 30), 101M steps (the file); stopped. The rail hover did not move (rail practice pucks never touched 36%, v4.4.10 38%; long rest spells in about 1 game in 45): the potential at 30 per metre is worth 2-3 points for closing to a puck, too little to matter. Defending calmer still (lunge 26 mm), shots as hard (6.7 m/s), concedes 0.18 a minute. Not for the table. Sim only.

v4.4.12.summary: v4.4.11 continued with the rail approach potential at 1000 per metre, 50M steps (the file); stopped. WORSE: rail practice pucks never touched 47% (v4.4.11 36%), now on the left rail too; long rest spells in about 1 game in 30; placed resting pucks left 6.1%. Do not use. Sim only.

v4.4.13.summary: v4.4.11 continued with side-rail drills started at motor loads of at most 0.6 of the limit (--edge-drill-max-load 0.6), 101M steps (the file); stopped. THE RAIL HOVER IS GONE without imitation: rail practice pucks never touched 21% (36%), cold right-rail ones 11% (67%); rest spells of 4 s or more 1 in 448 games (10, to 59 s). Calm defending kept (forward lunge on fast shots 16 mm, v4.1.2 150), shots as hard (6.7 m/s on target, 73% on target, 43% from a controlled puck), concedes 0.18 a minute, level with v4.1.2 (20-20), load peak 0.94 in the rigid sim. Still leaves 8.7% of placed pucks at the front edge of reach. Sim only.

v4.4.14.summary: v4.4.13 continued with the safe-load start for every stationary drill puck at the edge of reach (--fringe-drill-max-load 0.6), 303M steps (the file). The best all-round model of the self-play line: 45% of shots from a controlled puck, 73% on target at 6.7 m/s, 34 prepared fast on-target shots per 100 possessions (v4.3.12 12), concedes 0.18 a minute, beats v4.1.2 22-15 head to head, forward lunge on fast shots 25 mm (v4.1.2 150), load peak 0.84. Placed resting pucks left 0.9% (v4.1.2 1.0%; front edge 0.4%, side rails 7.7%); in 448 games no puck left longer than 5.6 s. Earlier snapshots of this run were weak on the left rail (101M, 202M), and left-rail practice pucks are still left 29% of the time from cold. The UI level 'calm'. Sim only.

v4.4.15.summary: v4.4.14 continued unchanged from its final (400M) snapshot; stopped at 45M steps to free the GPU for v4.4.16. No snapshot evaluated. Sim only.

v4.4.16.summary: v4.4.14 continued from its 303M snapshot with mirrored imitation of its own rail-zone successes (--mirror-success-weight 1), 50M steps (the file); stopped. MUCH WORSE: placed resting pucks left 11% (0.9%), a puck left lying for 4 s or more in 52 of 448 games (3), both rails now equally bad (about 30% of cold rail practice pucks never touched), shots on target 66% (73%), concedes 0.27 a minute (0.18). Do not use; kept as the record of a failed mechanism. Sim only.
